page.content:
July 1969 mission that first landed people on the Moon.

How Apollo 11 connects

  • Faction: Apollo program — Apollo 11 was the first landing mission of the Apollo program.
  • Character: Neil Armstrong — Neil Armstrong commanded Apollo 11 and first stepped onto the Moon.
  • Item: Saturn V — Apollo 11 left Earth on a Saturn V from Kennedy Space Center.
  • Character: Buzz Aldrin — Buzz Aldrin was the lunar module pilot on Apollo 11.
  • Character: Michael Collins — Michael Collins piloted the Apollo 11 command module in lunar orbit.
  • Location: Kennedy Space Center — Apollo 11 launched from Kennedy Space Center's Launch Complex 39.

What is Apollo 11?

Apollo 11 launched from Kennedy Space Center on 16 July 1969, landed Eagle on 20 July, and returned Armstrong, Aldrin, and Collins to Earth on 24 July.

Key threads lead to Apollo program, Neil Armstrong, Saturn V, Buzz Aldrin, Michael Collins and Kennedy Space Center.
